macrs_class_years.note: MACRS class for wind/solar that fails the eligibility gate is unverifiable (R3 §6).

wind_solar_cutoffs.rule: eligible if placed in service by 2027-12-31, OR construction began by 2026-07-04 (with continuity: PIS by Dec 31 of BOC year + 4)

notice_2025_42.value: vacated 2026-06-06 (Oregon Environmental Council v. IRS, D.D.C. No. 25-4400); 5% safe harbor restored; appeal/stay status unverified

material_assistance_thresholds.note: The 2030 value applies to construction beginning in 2030 or later (R3 A8).

boc_continuity.note: Placed in service by 31 Dec of the 4th calendar year after the BOC year is the continuity safe harbor; later is facts and circumstances (R3 G3).

boc_methods.src: Notice 2025-42 §6.01-6.03 and §7 (R3 A9, rows G4 and G6)
boc_methods.note: BOC before 2025-09-02 by any method, and solar <= 1.5 MW ac on the 5% test, are outside the Notice. Other 5%-only BOC rests on the 2026-06-06 vacatur (notice_2025_42, contingent).

small_facility_full_rate.note: Below 1 MW ac the full (30% / 3.1 c) rate applies without prevailing wage and apprenticeship.

energy_community.src: IRC §48E(a)(3)(A), §45Y(g)(7); P.L. 119-21 §70512/70513 contain no energy-community amendment (R3 A3)
energy_community.note: User sets it from the location (2026 list: IRS Notice 2026-39). Off unless the user says it is met.

domestic_content.src: IRC §48E(a)(3)(B) as amended by P.L. 119-21 §70513(d) (R3 A3)
domestic_content.note: User evidence. The §45Y parallel to the tightened test is unverifiable (R3 A3); offshore wind thresholds are not modelled.

ptc_adders_combine.src: R3 A3 ('PTC x1.10' per adder); each adder applied as +10% of the base amount
ptc_adders_combine.note: Both adders give 1.20 x the base rate, not 1.21.

low_income.value: not applicable to the siting screen
low_income.note: Competitive Treasury allocation, facilities under 5 MW ac only; cannot be self-claimed.

ptc_escalation.src: R3 A2: user inflation input, default the NREL ATB 2025 inflation
ptc_escalation.note: The real factor is the GDP deflator; rates after 2026 are estimates.

credit_choice.src: R3 A2 (storage has no PTC), A6, §3.2 (choose the higher NPV)

macrs_5yr_half_year.src: IRS Pub. 946 Table A-1, 5-year, half-year convention (R3 §3.2)
macrs_5yr_half_year.note: Standard table, not re-read in R3. Only reaches the cash flow when bonus depreciation is elected out.
